lines.text: *Rumbleeee*
A distant roar grows closer, and the ground begins to tremble intermittently.
We remain alert as we begin our strategy meeting.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: I have something to ask first.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Are Drake and Maxwell safe?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We have to believe so. Same with Bahamut.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: The Queen is made of Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Normally, Dark Matter changes into other substances to create a body, but that hasn't happened yet.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: She might not be able to because she's still newborn.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: In other words, she won't have melted down anything she's absorbed,

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: so there's a chance the three of them are still intact.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: That could mean that only their bodies are intact, though... right?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: B-but the Queen looked so small. Did all three of them really fit in there...?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I don't think so. I believe her structure is similar to Gluttony's.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Beneath her childlike form is likely a vast domain of Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That's right. I'm pretty sure it spreads far and wide underground, and that she can travel around it freely.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Th-that means they might be able to survive in there, like we can!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: If there's something akin to bubbles protecting them, maybe.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It'll depend on the concentration of Dark Matter they're stored in.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: If it's like what Leviathan once trapped me in, then they should be fine.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I was able to breathe without issue and even speak.
Leviathan, how big do you think the Queen's domain is?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text:
At minimum, it stretches to the Furnace from where we fought,
since she just popped up out of nowhere back there.
How much Dark Matter did you use to make the Queen, and how concentrated was it?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Oh, I see where you're going with this.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You want me to gauge the size of the Queen's domain based on the amount and concentration of Dark Matter we used, right?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's probably not that dense.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: About the same as what I used to trap Rapi, maybe a little thicker.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Hah!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Good!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: We've got at least two possible reasons they could still be alive! That's all I needed to hear!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: A hero can save the day with just two-tenths of a reason, let alone two whole ones! That's more than enough!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: There's no such thing as two-tenths of a reason.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Worry not! Baphomet will be fine, too.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's Bahamut.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What can we expect about the Queen's abilities?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: She's tough. She can condense her Dark Matter to the extreme.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yeah, for a brief moment I trapped one of her hands in bubbles, it felt unbelievably heavy.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It probably weighed the same as two of us.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Then it's probably safe to say that her child form is made of even more densely concentrated Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I guess most attacks won't work. But mine will.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Yeah, if anyone can pull it off, it's you, Cinderella.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Laplace, too, since Drake's attack managed to burn the Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Yeah, and I'm way stronger than Drake, so I can burn it better than her!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: S-so you're saying the Queen's not invincible.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: She's just really tough and... heavy.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Nothing we can't pierce through, though.
The real problem is all those hands.
Once they grab and absorb someone, she can use their powers.
We need to know Bahamut's abilities so that we can be prepared.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Th-then we should also know what the red girl and the yellow girl are capable of.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Drake can control electricity with extreme precision. You thought the dinosaur was impressive? She can shape it to look like Syuen!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Uh... I d-don't know what Syuen is, but th-that sounds impressive!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: As for Maxwell...

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: She's super good at nagging!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That has nothing to do with combat.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: She does other stuff, too, like... she fires Infinity Rails from her gun, I think?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: You mean a railgun. I-I'm well aware of that, c-considering she used it to pierce my wings.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Oh, right! That's it!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I see you have someone like Bahamut on your end, too.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You think there's only one?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Bahamut uses a huge pillar that she can control freely.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Its surface emits blue flames.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: She originally used it to transport molten materials by sticking them to it.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Unlike Ziz, who collects high-grade materials, Bahamut focuses more on gathering large quantities.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: In battle, she either rolls the pillar or slams it down.
Can she transform?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: No. Not yet, at least.
Good. That's something to keep in mind.
Now, our top priority is to rescue the three of them.
I think we need to enter the Queen's domain and make sure they're there.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'll go.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Considering how highly concentrated the Dark Matter might be, someone who's used to it should go.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm the one who handles Dark Matter best.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'll go inside and look for them.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I'll go with you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Why? You can't fly inside Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Still, I want to go with you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm not going to be reckless again. I can go alon—

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I don't believe you. I'm going with you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Fine...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I can be of help as well. I'll come, too.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: No, you stay here.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I don't want to put you in a dark place again.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Dark Matter is like your bubbles, but it's not the same. It's dangerous.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah...
Cinderella and Laplace, you handle the hands.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Sure! Those infernal black hands are nothing compared to our heroic power!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: The heroes' light will banish the darkness!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Just out of curiosity, I can't be paired with anyone else, can I?
Correct.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Okay... I'll respect your wish.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: I'm counting on you, Cinderella! Oooh, and we should start thinking of a catchphrase for our joint attacks!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: That... won't be necessary.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Good luck, Cinderella.
Siren and Grave, you provide support.
Writer's Eraser and bubbles are versatile.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah wooah.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Got it.
Rapi and Behemoth, I want you to attack the Queen directly.
You'll both be able to fend off her hands while applying pressure.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Roger.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Sounds good. We should sync up, Rapi.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I think you'll have trouble keeping up with me.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Well, I'll need you to back me up if things go south. I've got a secret weapon.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What secret weapon?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: If I told you, it wouldn't be secret, would it?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Now I'm curious...
Mori.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Yes, Evaluator? How can I help...?
Proceed south to where our transport and allies are.
Brief them on the situation and help them prepare for an immediate withdrawal.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Wait, do you mean...?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Understood. I'll handle it.
Thank you.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: No, thank you for being so considerate.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Mori...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I-it's okay, it's okay.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'll head out now, then!
Thanks again.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You bet!
Mori runs off.
... I'm sorry, Mori.
That leaves us with...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: The Offspring.
*Rumble rumble...*
The tremors and the roaring persist.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: We're really doing this.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Humans, imposters, and half-baked Heretics,

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: all teaming up to take down the fake Queen.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I hate you.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Good. I hate you too.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: You're Mother's failed creations.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: There's no reason for us to like each other.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: But since our cooperation's temporary and it helps me toward my goal, I can stomach it.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We're the ones who have to stomach it.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We could take out a weakened Offspring like you as though you were nothing.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I'm sure you could.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: But I wouldn't recommend it. There's nothing for you to gain in doing so.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It'd make us feel better.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: You'd go through the trouble of killing me just to make yourself feel better? You're so emotional.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Maybe you are broken. You've been hanging out too much with the imposters.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'll kill you!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Levi. There's no need for such harsh language.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Sh-she's the one who started it!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I don't want to hear you speaking like that.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Okay. I won't.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: L-Levi didn't talk back.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Yeah, not a single retort.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You're Liberalio, right?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Yeah. And you're Little Mermaid.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'd ask you not to speak in a hurtful manner either.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: We're all in this together.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: It's only temporary anyway.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Once we achieve our goal, there's no telling what could happen.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: You'll never understand one another, and neither will I.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: We're inherently different.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: And because of that, we can never have a truly meaningful conversation.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Conversation isn't just about trading words.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: It's about changing each other. That's the driving force behind it.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... Conversation is the cornerstone of evolution.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: You can't change others. The way you were created makes it impossible.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You're wrong.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Despite our differences, it's possible.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I agree.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Everyone standing here right now,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: we've all changed.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: ... I hope it isn't temporary.
Liberalio, you head to the Furnace.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: The place where the fake Queen was made?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Wait, why are you sending her there?
There may still high concentrations of Dark Matter there, even if only a little.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That's true, but...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Wait. Don't tell me you're...
Go there and recover. Try and come back in one piece.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I'll pass. I don't want to get contaminated by whatever filth that thing was made of.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: The only filth around here is coming out of your mouth. Maybe I should plug it with my fist.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: D-do you have any idea how hard we worked to make that?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Well, thanks to your hard work, we're in this mess right now.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Fine, don't use the Furnace. Just go on being annoying.
You can't help us right now, not in your current state.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I'm the only reason you were able to see your friends again.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: And don't forget that I helped back there with Gluttony.
I know, but it's still not enough. We expect more from a Heretic.
I want you to be our secret weapon.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: ... That's fair.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I really am weak right now. You know it's bad when even the Four Beasts can insult you and they're not wrong.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Fine. I'll go recover.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Didn't I tell you not to use the Furnace?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Levi.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Argh! Fine!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You know the location, right? Just go in and immerse yourself, and it'll automatically repair whatever your body is lacking.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Just keep it clean, you got that?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I don't know how I could possibly keep something clean when it's already filthy, but I'll try.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I hate you so much, Offspring.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: The feeling's mutual.
Liberalio leaps into the sky and flies off.
All right.
Let's commence the rescue operation and assault on the Queen.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: But how do we find her?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Oh, that's easy.
*Rumbleeee*

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Just head toward that sound.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: She's probably fighting Gluttony right now.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Wait, if the Q-Queen gets eaten by Gluttony, isn't it all over?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: That won't happen.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I doubt it as well.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: If anything, it'll be the other way around.
